title.narrative: Himachal Pradesh Public Financial Management Capacity Building Program

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve the efficiency of Public Expenditure Management and Tax Administration in Himachal Pradesh.

The development objective of Himachal Pradesh Public Financial Management Capacity Building Program Project for India is to improve the efficiency of Public Expenditure Management and Tax Administration in Himachal Pradesh. This project has three components. 1) The first component, Improving efficiency of the Finance Department (FD) in an enhanced control environment, aims to contribute toward strengthening budget credibility; effective Public Financial Management (PFM) operations; and enhancing governance, financial controls, and accountability by strengthening treasury systems and establishing or upgrading enabling IT systems. It has two subcomponents as follows: (i) Strengthening treasury functioning and implementing second generation Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS) reforms; (ii) Strengthening PFM Reforms Architecture; and (iii) Establishing or strengthening enabling IT systems and support. 2) The second component, Increasing efficiency and performance through better contract management, aims to strengthen contract management in one of the major works departments, namely the Irrigation and Public Health (IPH) Department. It has the following two subcomponents: (i) Establishing an integrated CMS; and (ii) Rollout of e-Procurement in all government departments. 3) The third component, Unlocking revenue potential through modernization of the Excise and Taxation Department (ETD), aims to support activities that will increase efficiency in operations within the ETD, including upgrading skills and competency levels for improved staff capacity and enhanced systems, both with the objective of augmentation and increasing revenue. It has the following five subcomponents: (i) Diagnostic of the institutional framework and revenue administration; (ii) Strengthening analytical skills and business intelligence (BI) capabilities; (iii) e-Governance in the excise function; (iv) Independent third-party IT audit; and (v) Hiring of personnel for addressing backlog of Value Added Tax (VAT) and Central Sales Tax (CST) assessments.

condition.narrative: Himachal Pradesh to (i) not later than 03 months after Effectiveness Date, appoint an independent verification agency (IVA) underterms and reference satisfactory to the Bank, to carry out the verification of compliance of DLIs, (ii) carry out a verificationprocess guided by a Verification Protocol agreed with the Bank, and (iii) furnish to the Bank the corresponding verificationreports in form and substance acceptable to the Bank, not later than 30 days after the end of each of the periods under review, inorder to submit evidence satisfactory to the Bank of the achievement of said DLIs for disbursement.

Himachal Pradesh to: (i) join the Bank in the carrying out of a Mid-Term Review to assess the overall progress in implementation ofthe Program; (ii) prepare and furnish to the Bank, at least three (3) months prior to such review, a report, in scope and detailacceptable to the Bank, needed to undertake the review; and (iii) review, jointly with the Bank, the report referred above andthereafter take all measures required to ensure the efficient completion of the Program and the achievement of the objectivesthereof, based on the conclusions and recommendations of said report and the Bank's views on the matter.

In the event that: (i) a reversal of a previous DLI has occurred in a manner that would, in the opinion of the Bank, adverselyaffect the achievement of the objectives of the Program; and (ii) said previous DLI has already been vetted by the IVA(s) using theVerification Protocol agreed with the Bank, and for which the corresponding disbursements have been already made by the Bank; theBorrower shall refund the disbursements already made by the Bank for said previous DLIs.

The Borrower may withdraw: (i) an amount not to exceed US$ 7,200,000 as an advance; provided, however, that if the DLIs in theopinion of the Bank, are not achieved (or only partially achieved) by the Closing Date, the Borrower shall refund such advance tothe Bank promptly upon notice thereof by the Bank. Except as otherwise agreed with the Borrower, the Bank shall cancel the amountso refunded. Any further withdrawals requested as an advance under any Category shall be permitted only on such terms andconditions as the Bank shall specify by notice to the Borrower.

The Borrower shall cause Himachal Pradesh to ensure that the Program is carried out in accordance with financial management,procurement and environmental and social management systems mutually acceptable to the Bank, including those set out in the ESSA,the Program Manual and the Program Action Plan (“Program Fiduciary, Environmental and Social Systems”).
The Borrower shall cause Himachal Pradesh to maintain at all times during implementation, a Program Steering Committee to providestrategic leadership and inter-departmental coordination.

title.narrative: Backlog of pending VAT/ CST assessments reduced

baseline.value: Pending tax assessments (VAT and CST) is 294,000 (2011/12–2015/16)

title.narrative: Increased value of transactions processed through the e-Procurement system

baseline.value: Software implemented in 5 departments and 15 parastatals with sporadic usage (of the six modules) and value of transactions processed at INR 24.41 billion for value of tenders uploaded and INR 1.88 billion for value of contracts awarded

comment.narrative: <p>Target achieved in advance. Achievement has been sustained in 2021–22 and till Project closure.</p>

actual.value: Target achieved for FY 21 - 22. Value of transactions processed through the e-Procurement system increased by 90% over baseline.

title.narrative: Strengthening PFM in the state by provision of comprehensive and wide-ranging training

baseline.value: Training neither strategic nor according to a plan

comment.narrative: <p>Regular trainings conducted on IFMIS, GST, gender issues, Treasury Rules, usage of application software, NPS etc. These needs were identified in consultation with senior administrators, staff of various departments and external stakeholders. The training was based on a training plan and was informed by a Training Needs Assessment. </p>

actual.value: Regular trainings are being conducted on IFMIS, GST, gender issues, Treasury Rules, usage of application software, NPS etc.

title.narrative: Reduce variance between originally approved budget to expenditure

baseline.value: Variance (absolute) between originally approved budget to expenditure outturns of six large departments (demand heads) was 19% (FY2015–16)

comment.narrative: <p>GoHP has achieved and maintained the achievement in 2021-22 and sustained it till Project closure. </p>

actual.value: GoHP has achieved and maintained the target in 2021-22 as well.

comment.narrative: <p>Rollout is complete at all 60 divisions, and they are generating their monthly accounts from CMS. Legacy system has been discontinued.</p>

title.narrative: Enhanced capacity of officials implementing GST by providing training not covered by the sovereign function

baseline.value: GST rollout training to be imparted and systematic training instituted for the department

comment.narrative: <p>An Audit training module has been prepared and about 1,000 tax inspectors have been trained on tax audit.</p>

actual.value: An Audit training module has been prepared and about 1,000 tax inspectors have been trained on tax audit.

title.narrative: Electronic Interface of IFMIS implemented in all departments

baseline.value: Manual submission of bills from departments (through 4700 DDOs) to treasuries and manual submission to the AG

target.value: Treasury inspection function and the HPSAD strengthened

comment.narrative: <p>Roll out to all DDOs is completed. Treasury inspection software is rolled out and SOP approved. Audit Code has been finalized and Audit Management System has been developed.</p>

actual.value: Roll out to all DDOs is completed. Treasury inspection software is rolled out and SOP approved. Audit Code has been finalized and Audit Management System has been developed.

baseline.value: Nascent citizen engagement on budget; no disclosure of contract information; fiscal information only through standard reports

comment.narrative: <p>FD has added more reports over time on public domain including visualization tools. Citizen participation (citizens, industry groups, tax practitioners) in budget process has been ensured during the 2023-24 annual budget preparation.</p>

actual.value: FD has added more reports over time on public domain. Citizen participation in budget process has been ensured during for the past three years annual budgets.

title.narrative: e-Governance application for excise function implemented

baseline.value: No e-Governance application for excise function

comment.narrative: <p> The e-Governance system has been rolled out with identified licensees onboarded. It has gone live from April/ May 2023 and earlier manual systems have been discontinued. </p>

actual.value: The e-Governance system has been rolled out with identified licensees onboarded.

title.narrative: Strengthening components of the PFM cycle through analytical studies of the core FD functions

baseline.value: No recent studies (last review during PEFA 2009) conducted to refine the core functions

comment.narrative: <p>Debt Management Performance Assessment (DeMPA) is complete, and its recommendations translated into DLI 2. Action taken by GoHP on expenditure management in terms of scheme rationalization and consolidation. MAPS (Procurement Assessment) was also commissioned during the Program period.</p>

actual.value: Debt Management Performance Assessment (DeMPA) is complete, and its recommendations translated into DLI 2.

title.narrative: Institutional performance of the ETD improved

baseline.value: No specialized units; recovery process is weak

comment.narrative: <p>Specialized units have been set up and operating</p>

actual.value: Specialized units have been set up and operating.

title.narrative: Institutional strengthening and modernization of the ETD

baseline.value: Weak institutional and organization structure and obsolete e-applications

comment.narrative: <p>New specializations created, that is Economic Intelligence Unit, Audit Unit and Service Tax Unit. These units have been staffed and are fully functional - providing analysis, audit findings and advise respectively. The department has been reorganized based on functional specializations. </p>

actual.value: EIU has been established and others are also progressing. Training is going on.

title.narrative: Internal Controls of the FD strengthened

baseline.value: Weak internal controls: specific FM functions still manual

comment.narrative: <p>Revised Treasury Rules notified and published on FD website. Online budget preparation software has been used for preparing annual budgets. This has streamlined the process and increased transparency. Debt Management module has been implemented including coverage of guarantees - process has changed from manual to automated; improving internal controls, facilitating analysis and generating prompts. </p>

actual.value: Revised Treasury Rules notified and published on FD website. Online budget preparation process has been used for preparing annual budgets. Debt Management module has been implemented including coverage of guarantees.
